summary:
Iteration 21 — Release-2 verification: COMPLETED a real Stripe hosted-checkout payment end-to-end on the preview URL and confirmed the order flips to paid in admin, plus verified the newly added password-reset flow, branded-email non-blocking behavior (Resend gated), admin tracking_number input, and fulfillment_status enum tightening.

BACKEND (pytest, 11/11 passed in /app/backend/tests/test_store_release2.py):
  * POST /api/store/auth/register → 200 with token+user; welcome email attempted but skipped (RESEND_API_KEY empty) — no error.
  * POST /api/store/auth/register with duplicate email → 409.
  * POST /api/store/auth/forgot returns {ok:true} for both existing and unknown emails (no account-existence leak); email send skipped gracefully.
  * POST /api/store/auth/reset with badtoken → 400; missing fields → 422.
  * PATCH /api/store/admin/orders/{id} persists {fulfillment_status:'shipped', tracking_number:'1Z999...'} (verified via GET /admin/orders). Invalid fulfillment_status 'in_production' → 422 (now a strict Literal). All 5 valid states (unfulfilled/processing/shipped/delivered/cancelled) accepted. Unknown order → 404.
  * GET /api/store/admin/orders returns {orders,total,paidCount,revenue} with correct types.

FRONTEND (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080):
  * COMPLETE STRIPE PURCHASE (previously skipped): Added /store/product/ccdp-hoodie → size XS → Add to Cart → /store/cart → guest email qa_stripe_49e9141f@example.com → checkout-btn redirected to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a1D10N…. Filled shipping (Test Buyer, 123 Test St, Chicago, IL 60601, US, phone 3125551234), selected Card radio, entered 4242 4242 4242 4242 / 12/34 / 123, clicked Pay. Redirected back to /store/order/success?session_id=cs_test_... and order-success card rendered: 'Thank you for your order! · Order ord_e6586a7ccc53 · CCDP Hoodie · XS × 1 · $68.00 · Total paid $68.00'. Admin API confirms paidCount=1 and revenue=68.0.
  * /admin/orders after admin login: stat-total-orders=14, stat-paid-orders=1, stat-revenue=$68.00 (previously $0.00 with paidCount=0). Order ord_e6586a7ccc53 row shows 'paid' badge.
  * Admin tracking input: filled tracking-{ord_e6586a7ccc53}='1Z999AA10123456784' + blur → 'Order updated.' toast appeared and value persisted through a full page reload (verified via input.input_value() after reload). PATCH endpoint fires with tracking_number persisted server-side.
  * Password reset flow: /store/login shows 'Forgot your password?' link (forgot-link) → clicks to /store/forgot → submitting forgot-email + forgot-submit displays forgot-sent 'Check your email' card. /store/reset with no token shows 'This reset link is missing or invalid.' /store/reset?token=badtoken12345&email=someone@example.com → filling reset-password + reset-submit → backend 400 + sonner toast 'Invalid or expired reset link.' (confirmed via console error and visible toast).
action_items: None blocking. All Release-2 acceptance criteria met including the previously-skipped full Stripe hosted payment (order ord_e6586a7ccc53 = paid, $68.00).

NICE-TO-HAVE (carryover from iter 20): the StoreLogin.jsx 'setState during render' React warning still likely exists — not re-tested this run since login was not the focus. Consider wrapping the redirect-if-authed navigate() in useEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend now correctly types OrderStatusBody.fulfillment_status as Literal['unfulfilled','processing','shipped','delivered','cancelled'] (verified: 'in_production' → 422). Prior iter-20 gap is fixed.
store_email.send() is non-blocking (asyncio.create_task) and returns None when RESEND_API_KEY is absent — verified register/checkout/PATCH-shipped paths all return 2xx even with emails disabled.

_sync_paid gates the 'send confirmation email' side-effect on email_status != 'sent' (idempotent). Good — but relies on the order having .email; guest checkout stores email so this works. Consider also gating on 'email' truthy explicitly (already done).

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 new Release-2 tests + 25/25 prior store tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows including full Stripe hosted-checkout payment

seed_data_creation: Created 1 real PAID order via Stripe test card (ord_e6586a7ccc53, $68.00, email qa_stripe_49e9141f@example.com) with tracking_number=1Z999AA10123456784 and fulfillment_status=shipped-then-* per admin tests. Plus ~6 additional pending guest orders from checkout redirect tests, and ~2 TEST_ customer accounts (test_rel2_*@example.com and qa_stripe_*@example.com). No existing data was deleted.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full Release-2 acceptance passed. Real paid order ord_e6586a7ccc53 exists in DB with tracking 1Z999AA10123456784. If retesting Stripe hosted checkout, note: the Card payment tile in Stripe hosted-checkout is a radio input inside an accordion whose visible label is intercepted by a hidden accordion button — clicking must be done via input[type='radio'][value='card'].check(force=True), then card fields (#cardNumber/#cardExpiry/#cardCvc) become visible. Address panel exposes direct inputs after clicking the 'Enter address manually' link. All password-reset testids exist: forgot-link (StoreLogin), forgot-email/forgot-submit/forgot-sent (ForgotPassword), reset-password/reset-submit (ResetPassword). Admin tracking input testid: tracking-{order_id}. Admin stat testids: stat-total-orders, stat-paid-orders, stat-revenue.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects. Both iter-20 minor issues are fixed (Literal enum on fulfillment_status enforced; stat-paid-orders testid added to AdminOrders.jsx).
